_about: Settings per board for one bundle of an architecture (docs/bundle.md, Board profiles). scripts/package/board_profile.py picks the first profile whose match is in /proc/device-tree/model or compatible. 'install' is applied once, at install, only to the settings nobody has set (option ids of options.json, then cfg keys of game/<file>); 'run' is worked out at each start: env (when the variable is not set already) and Godot arguments (when the command line has none of that name), each only if its 'if' holds.
